name: B10-0424/2026 – § 5 – Am 130
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 5. Calls on the Council to adopt a decision to include hate speech and hate crime among the criminal offences within the list under Article 83(1) TFEU, as proposed by the Commission as far back as 2021, so that the Commission can initiate the second stage of the procedure to extend the EU legal basis to cover hate crimes and hate speech;
